question: Who among the following launched the nationwide programme of Fit India Freedom Run 2.0?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anurag Thakur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Union Minister Anurag Thakur launched the Fit India Freedom Run 2.0 on August 13, 2021.
 
• The event was launched to commemorate the 75th Independence Day of India.
 
• The Fit India Freedom Run 2.0 is part of the Fit India Movement, which aims to promote fitness and health among Indians.
 
• The run covers a distance of 7.5 km, symbolizing 75 years of India's independence.
 
• It encourages citizens to participate in physical activities and stay healthy amidst the COVID-19 pandemic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fit India Movement**

 
 
• Launched by PM Narendra Modi on August 29, 2019, to encourage Indians to include physical activity and sports in their everyday lives.
 
• Aims to inspire people to adopt a fit and healthy lifestyle.
 
• Various programs and initiatives are organized under this movement to promote fitness.
 
 
 
• **Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav**
 
 
• It is an initiative by the Government of India to celebrate and commemorate 75 years of independence.
 
• It was launched on March 12, 2021, by PM Narendra Modi.
 
• Includes various events and activities to honor the freedom fighters and their contributions to India's independence.
 
 
 
• **National Sports Day**
 
 
• Celebrated on August 29 each year to honor the birth anniversary of hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand.
 
• On this day, the President of India honors eminent sports personalities with various awards.
 
• Aims to promote sports and physical activities across the country.
 
 
 
• **COVID-19 and Physical Activity**
 
 
• Regular physical activity is crucial for maintaining health during the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• It helps in boosting the immune system and reducing stress and anxiety.
 
• Various online fitness programs and challenges have been introduced to keep people active while maintaining social distancing.
